Reflections:On Cinematography
is the book you’ve been asking for. Roger shares his journey from English country boy to the very different world of Hollywood and speaks in depth on the lighting of his many films. The book releases on November 11th.
To get a signed copy that will be shipped anywhere, order from the ASC bookstore.
